RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.label: probe
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.arrivalLetterText:
A pod has come down well away from the colony. An Imperial probe droid of {FACTION} is drifting toward us to look.

If it watches our people or the ship long enough (about two hours of clear sight) it will transmit what it saw, and the search will move on to its next step.

Three ways to beat it: destroy it before it transmits (it self-destructs when killed, so stand back), keep everyone out of its sight (indoors, in the dark, under the hull), or simply let it leave having seen nothing.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.successLetterText: The probe saw us and sent its report. {FACTION} will send someone to confirm it.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.failLetterText: The probe is gone and it reported nothing. The search holds where it was.

RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.label: spotter
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.arrivalLetterText:
A small scout team of {FACTION} has walked in and is taking position at range. They are not here to fight. One of them carries the comm-link and is calling in what he sees.

If he watches the colony or the ship for about six hours the call goes through and a strike team follows.

Kill or down the spotter and the rest will leave. Or launch now. Or keep him from seeing anything at all.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.successLetterText: The spotter's call got through. {FACTION} knows where we are. A strike will follow.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.failLetterText: The scouts are pulling back without having called us in. The search holds.

RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.label: strike
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.warningLetterText: {FACTION} is sending a strike team to confirm what it found. They land in about twelve hours.\n\nBeat them, or be gone before they arrive.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.arrivalLetterText: Troopers and attack droids of {FACTION} are dropping in groups at the edge of the map.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.successLetterText: We did not drive them off. {FACTION} will tighten the net: next comes a cordon around the ship.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.failLetterText: The strike team is broken. That buys us time, but {FACTION} will try again.

RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.label: cordon
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.warningLetterText: {FACTION} is moving an ion emplacement into range of the ship. In about a day they will set up a siege camp.\n\nOnce it is in place, ion volleys will knock the grav engine out for a few hours at a time. Never for days: the way out stays open. Launch before the first volley, or break the camp.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.arrivalLetterText: A siege team of {FACTION} has arrived to pin the ship down. The first ion volley comes in about a day. Each one stalls the grav engine for a few hours.\n\nAssault the camp, or launch while the engine is clear.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.successLetterText: The cordon stood for two days. {FACTION} is bringing breachers.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.failLetterText: The siege camp is broken. The ship is free.

RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.label: breach
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.warningLetterText: {FACTION} is coming in hard: breachers at the walls and a second team dropped straight into the colony. About six hours.\n\nWin a hard fight, or leave.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.arrivalLetterText: Two Imperial assaults at once: breachers cutting through the walls, and a second team dropping into the middle of the colony.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.successLetterText: We did not drive them off. {FACTION} has stopped trying to take us. A Star Destroyer is moving into orbit.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.failLetterText: Both assaults are broken. {FACTION} will try again.

RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.label: bombardment
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.arrivalLetterText: {FACTION} has a Star Destroyer overhead. In one day it will bombard the marked area around the ship, and it will destroy buildings.\n\nThis cannot be fought. Leave. After the bombardment, the waves will not stop until we do.
RuthlessPursuingMechanoids.RUT_EmpireRun.successLetterText: The bombardment has begun. {FACTION} will keep coming until we leave this place.
